Zara (PM): Heads-up  usability sessions showed a confusing moment: after dragging a rule to a new position, the simulator sometimes still reflects the previous order until you toggle a filter. Repro: create 5 rules, drag #4 to top, open simulator.

Ike (Eng-UX): Repro'd on Chrome. We snapshot DOM order for the simulator; race with React state updates causes stale reads.

Mina (Design): Users assumed the change didn't apply. We should avoid any mismatch between list and simulator. Small visual hint would help.

Tom (A11y): Keyboard reorder also has a problem: screen reader announces the old index after move. Need explicit announcement: "Moved to position 1 of 5".

Ike (Eng-UX): Plan: 1) take simulator ordering from canonical store after commit (safer than DOM), 2) show a brief simulator loading indicator "Applying changes..." with aria-live=polite, 3) add small transient badge next to index while dragging that says "will be #1".

Zara (PM): Sounds good. Also product wants conflict messages to be more helpful. Current: "Conflict". Change to: "Rule conflict: 'header=X' overlaps with rule 'EU traffic' on field 'geo'  consider narrowing condition or lowering priority".

Mina (Design): I'll draft microcopy variants (long/short) and tooltip text for the transient badge. Also propose a toast: "Simulator updated" when the new order is reflected.

Tom (A11y): Shimmer / toast must be exposed via aria-live and focusable if it contains actions (e.g., "Undo"). For undo after auto-commit, ensure undo restores previous focus.

Ike (Eng-UX): Good notes. I'll implement store-based capture + aria-live + stable ids so focus can be restored. Backend already returns conflict ids; we'll map to display names for the improved copy. Will add unit tests mocking timing.

BuildBot: CI started for branch feat/sim-order-fix (build 2310).

Zara (PM): Default behavior: auto-commit ordering for hosted users, manual save for enterprise behind flag. Add an "Apply order" CTA when not auto-commit.

Mina (Design): Agree. Uploading badge visuals and color tokens for dark mode contrast fixes.

Tom (A11y): Will run contrast checks and provide accept criteria. Also specifying SR announcements: "Order saved" and "Moved to position X".

Ike (Eng-UX): Draft PR link in a bit. Will include RTL/Jest tests + an a11y e2e for keyboard reorder.

BuildBot: Build 2310 passed, integration tests 29/31 (2 flaky).
